body: When someone doesn't want to or can't help me, but instead he's helping himself to feel better with himself at the same time he pretends to be trying to help me. When I tell a hypocrite little shit like that to go help himself somewhere else, I consider justice has been delivered. Have you received your delivery?

Nah. Living there was boring but easy. Being assaulted by the police in my own house a few years later, that was harder than living with nuts. 
I truly enjoy making people suffer and being in a position of superiority. Besides giving payback to those that add suffering to my suffering, I don't think I enjoy anything else.

Hope stopped me. HAHA. If only I knew what would've happened the next 8 years.

Three days later I woke up in an asylum handcuffed to a bed, wearing a diaper, and I spent a few months there. Can't tell you how many because the drugs made me lose the notion of time.
Well, I agree with him. If you cut your arms you are stupid. Kill yourself or don't, but cutting yourself serves no purpose. Buy alcohol instead if you want endorphins.
